text: ok now explain to me what the reset uv button does as it doesnt reset it in any way i expected it to
resolution: User asked what the UV panel's 'Reset UV' button does because it did not behave as expected. Explained: it called fullFaceUV(part.mesh), which rewrites every face's UV to map to the full texture square [0,1] (the Blockbench base-cube default). It does NOT touch geometry, does NOT undo loop cuts, and does NOT unfold the box-net atlas (that is the separate unwrap() 'create texture' step, Phase 5c, unwired). Because the default UV is already full-square-per-face, pressing it usually looked like nothing changed. This explanation led directly to req_1013 (the user asked to remove the button).
